🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona will submit a written appeal TOMORROW against Fermín López’s red card. The club’s intention is to challenge the referee’s classification of the incident as a protest, as stated in the official report.

Barça will argue that it was an isolated case of inappropriate conduct rather than a formal protest, hoping to have it assessed under a different disciplinary article. This could reduce Fermín’s suspension to just ONE MATCH. [@santiovalle] #fcblive

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona and Real Madrid president Florentino Pérez have a conciliation hearing scheduled for TOMORROW, November 25, at the Madrid Courts over his statements regarding the Negreira case.

Barça want Pérez to retract his claims that the club is corrupt and “stole” league titles. If he refuses, the club intend to file a criminal complaint against him for slander. [@gbsans] #fcblive

🚨 Frenkie de Jong's press conference ahead of the UCL game against Sabah FK: 

“It's important to start every game well. Sabah try to play out from the back, and we'll have to play well to win.” #fcblive #UCL 🔵

🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: “Getting stripped of captaincy? I don’t want to get into that again, but my relationship with the manager is good. I feel strong and I’m trying to focus on the present. What happened in past doesn't matter.” #fcblive 👏

🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: “I don’t feel any less like a starter. I’m back now, I’m feeling good and I have CONFIDENCE in myself. We’ll take it from there. I want to be a starter, as I always have.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong, on Lamine Yamal’s absence: “We’ll definitely MISS him. His talent and the chances he creates make a difference. However, we have a squad full of talent, and normally, we should be capable of winning tomorrow without him.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: “When you play for Barça, you have to prove your worth. I feel most comfortable in midfield, but I’ll ALWAYS play in other positions if the team needs me.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Frenkie de Jong: “I’ve said this several times before... I think the periods when people are unhappy with me or question my place in the team and my abilities always coincide with the summer break, the transfer window or periods when I’m injured. In other words, it always happens when I’m not playing.” #fcblive

Before leaving the room, a journalist from Azerbaijan asked Frenkie whether Lamine was missing the game because of GTA 6.

Frenkie's reaction: 😭

🚨 Hansi Flick's press-conference ahead of tomorrow's UCL game against Sabah FK:

“We have a lot of games coming up before the end of the year, and it’s important that all the players get minutes. We’ll try to manage things in the best possible way.” #fcblive #UCL

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Frenkie de Jong: “What I like most about him is that he can play in almost every position. He gives everything for the team. He’s a midfielder, but we’ll see where we need him tomorrow.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Lamine Yamal’s absence: “We’ve played without Lamine before, so I think we know what we have to do to win. Why was he rested? We examined him yesterday morning and then decided that it would be best for him to stay in Barcelona and rest.” #fcblive
